Subject: ArborTech merchant intake — legal entity, remit & banking kickoff

Hi Jae / Taylor —

Welcome — excited to get ArborTech set up in our procurement system. To keep finance and procurement moving, can you please provide the items below by EOD Wednesday (10/21)? If any of these are sensitive, feel free to send to marcus.lin@redwood.com directly.

Checklist (what we need):
- Legal entity name as registered (exact string for PO & tax)
- W-9 (or W-8BEN if non-US)
- Remit-to address (where invoices should be sent)
- Preferred payment method: ACH (preferred) or Wire
- For ACH: bank name, routing number, account number, account holder name, account type (checking/savings)
- For Wire: bank SWIFT/BIC, IBAN (if applicable), beneficiary name and address
- Tax ID / EIN and state of formation
- Primary billing contact (name, email, phone)

A couple of notes from our side:
- Default payment terms are Net 30 after invoice receipt; please flag if you require different terms — any exceptions will need procurement approval.
- We will issue PO numbers for all orders; please include PO on invoice to avoid delays.
- We use DocuSign for any master agreements; I can route to your legal team when you confirm the entity name.

I've attached our buyer intake form to make it easier to fill in details. Marcus from Finance is on copy for any bank verification questions.

Thanks — looking forward to wrapping this up quickly.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Sourcing Manager, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Hi Jae / Taylor —

Thanks for sending the W-9 and bank letter — that's a good start. For secure transmission of ACH credentials we can accept one of the following (choose whichever works best for you):
1) Upload to our vendor portal (preferred): https://redwood-inference.app/vendor-portal/ARB-4582 (I will provision access when you confirm the email to use).
2) Encrypted email (we can send a DocuSign/OneDrive secure upload link).
3) Call finance to read account details and confirm micro-deposit amounts (we will perform a single micro-deposit test).

Additional KYC we typically collect before activating ACH:
- Certificate of Incorporation / Articles of Organization
- Voided check or bank letter showing account name (we have the bank letter — good)
- Beneficial owner attestation (small questionnaire)

Operational notes:
- Once we have ACH info and KYC, we will create a vendor record and assign a vendor ID and first PO number (you will receive an automated email with PO#).
- Please send invoices that include our PO number and your EIN to: invoices@redwood.com. Invoices without PO will be routed to a manual queue and can take longer.
- If you need a different payment term (e.g., Net 45), please submit in writing to procurement@redwood.com; approval may take up to 5 business days.

Next steps for you: confirm which secure channel you prefer and we will send a one-time secure link or portal invite. Once upload complete I will reply with vendor ID and expected PO cadence.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Manager, Finance Operations — Payments & Vendor Setup

(415) 555-0128
